_comment: Known-good (date, dims, value) triples from official sources. The test reads data/*.csv and asserts these values match within tolerance. Only use revision-proof values: unadjusted/final figures, index base values, policy rates, population stocks. Never seasonally adjusted series (revised retroactively).
_tolerance: 1e-4 relative default; per-anchor 'tolerance' overrides (e.g. 0.01 = 1% for SA series)
